title: Snapshot
description: Balance of one cash account at the start of business date as_of (engine-spec §2 Snapshot). Events dated before as_of are taken as already reflected; events ON as_of are applied unless listed in includes_event_ids. Reflection is judged on the event as written, before any scenario moves or scales it (engine-spec §12.2); an event a scenario moves before as_of is not in the balance and counts on as_of. At most one snapshot per cash account.

observed_at.description: When the balance was observed (metadata; absent = unknown).

includes_event_ids.description: Events of this account dated on or before as_of that the balance ALREADY includes (an event dated after as_of is refused by every adapter). A set: order carries no meaning (but is part of the input hash).
